summary: NEXORIA V2 redesign verification — Bearer token auth flow + full RPG codex theming. Backend: 36/36 pytest pass (added new tests: register/login MUST return session_token in body; /auth/me works with Authorization: Bearer header alone — cookies cleared; Oracle response forbidden-words check verifies NO 'Claude/Anthropic/IA/intelligence artificielle/algorithme/modèle de langage'). Frontend: login stores token in localStorage ('nexoria_token', 64 chars); all 10 renamed sidebar nav labels render (Place Publique, Mon Héros, Constellation, Royaume, Reliques, Tableau de Chasse, Sanctuaire, Hall des Légendes, Panthéon, Conseil); Place Publique posting grants +20 XP with toast 'Votre voix résonne dans le royaume'; Sanctuaire shows 'Le Sanctuaire' + 'Salle des Murmures' with zero AI references; Tableau de Chasse, Reliques (chest modal shows 'Sceau brisé' + 'Révélation'), Constellation ('Étoiles à allumer' label, NOT 'Points de compétence'), Mon Héros ('Carte du Héros' + 'Empreinte éthérique'), Panthéon, Conseil admin tabs (Présage, Héros enregistrés, Chroniques) all verified. StarField canvas renders. Mobile bottom nav shows first 5 nav items.

minor.issue: Logout endpoint still relies on cookie ('request.cookies.get(session_token)') — does NOT read the Authorization Bearer token. With Bearer-only frontend, the server-side session row will not be deleted on logout (frontend just clears localStorage). Not breaking the V2 flow (frontend simply drops the token) but server-side session row is left until expiry.

action_items: (Optional, minor) Update /api/auth/logout to also accept Bearer token from Authorization header (read header if no cookie) so the user_sessions doc is deleted server-side when the frontend logs out in Bearer mode. Today the frontend just clears localStorage and the token row sits in MongoDB until expiry.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py get_current_user() correctly handles BOTH cookie and Authorization: Bearer fallback — clean implementation.
Login/Register endpoints expose session_token in the JSON body (V2 contract) while still setting the cookie (backwards compat) — good dual-mode support.

Oracle prompt explicitly forbids the 6 AI-related terms — verified at runtime with the new automated test (Oracle response checked for: claude, anthropic, intelligence artificielle, modèle de langage, algorithme, standalone 'IA'). Pass.
frontend/src/lib/api.js correctly sets withCredentials:false and injects Authorization Bearer from localStorage; integration verified end-to-end.
server.py is still 979 lines — recommend splitting into routers (auth, social, game, oracle, admin) for maintainability (carryover from iteration_1).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all renamed pages + Bearer flow + chest modal + toast verified)

test_credentials: Admin: admin@nexoria.com / NexoriaAdmin2026! — verified working. Bearer token in body (length 64) — verified. Frontend reads localStorage['nexoria_token'] and sends Authorization: Bearer <token>.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_<hex>@nexoria-test.com users and TEST grind 0..11 posts; one V2 admin post 'V2 test: la voix dans le royaume!' added to feed. Cleanup not performed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: V2 Bearer flow is solid. Run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_nexoria_api.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Frontend nav data-testid: nav-{feed,hero,skills,kingdom,inventory,quests,oracle,leaderboards,legends,admin}. Post composer testid is `post-composer` (NOT post-composer-input). For frontend text assertions on tracking-wide uppercase microlabels (e.g. 'Salle des Murmures', 'Étoiles à allumer', 'Carte du Héros', 'Empreinte éthérique', 'Sceau brisé') — Playwright .inner_text() may drop those due to CSS letter-spacing; use page.content() (HTML source) for reliable string match. The Oracle test consults Claude Sonnet 4.5 (~15s) — set timeout ≥60s.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. The V2 Bearer auth migration is fully functional: localStorage 'nexoria_token' is set on login/register, axios interceptor adds Authorization header, and get_current_user() reads Bearer or cookie. Oracle anti-AI prompt enforced — runtime test passes. All 10 renamed pages render correctly. Single minor gap: /auth/logout endpoint still reads only cookie (not header), so Bearer-only logouts don't delete the server-side session row — non-blocking.
